actual: Entering 'not-an-email' into the required Email field (declared format: email) did not block the Preview Result tab or show a validation error; the preview rendered '| not-an-email |' directly instead of rejecting the invalid value or keeping preview unavailable.

evidence: Entering '[link](javascript:alert(1))' etc. into Full Name triggered inline error 'Special characters like < > { } [ ] \\ | ` are not allowed' and disabled the Preview tab until removed, preventing structurally dangerous Markdown injection (links, code spans, tables, HTML).

issue: 'Oldest First' sort produces same order as 'Recently Updated'
actual: Category filter (Resume -> 1 of 6), Scenario filter (Academic -> 1 of 6), Popularity sort (1250,1100,890,720,560,340 descending), and Alphabetical sort all worked correctly. evidence: Category filter, scenario filter, favorites-only toggle, search query, and sort selection all updated templates.grid and filters.result-count immediately in the same page without navigation/reload.

actual: Searching 'Meting' (missing one letter of 'Meeting') and 'Resme' (missing letter of 'Resume') both returned 'Showing 0 of 6 templates' / 'No templates found' with no suggestions and no matching template, instead of returning or suggesting the intended template.

evidence: Typing 'res' (3 chars) showed a search.suggestions collection with 5 real-time suggestions; clicking 'Professional Resume' suggestion filled the search box with that text and narrowed results to 1 of 6.

After defining fields Project Name, Owner Name, Goal (each independently fillable and remaining in submit.fields list), attempting to Add Field again with duplicate label 'Goal' did not add a 4th field; submit.fields stayed at exactly 3 items (project_name, owner_name, goal).
Clicking Submit Template with all fields blank kept the dialog open and template count unchanged at 'Showing 6 of 6 templates', confirming blank submission is rejected.

Submitted a Markdown template 'Quick Project Kickoff Note' with title, description, author, category (Other), scenario (Business), content containing 3 placeholders, and 3 defined fields (project_name, owner_name, goal); submission succeeded.

Immediately after clicking Submit Template, templates.grid updated to include the new template and filters.result-count changed from 'Showing 6 of 6' to 'Showing 7 of 7 templates' without any page reload.

issue: Duplicate field labels are not properly rejected or disambiguated
actual: Adding a field labeled 'Goal' a second time (duplicate of an existing 'Goal' field) appeared to be silently ignored in the submit-form field list (still showed 3 fields: project_name, owner_name, goal), but after submitting, the template's fill form actually rendered TWO separate 'Goal' inputs sharing the same underlying id/key 'goal' (one required 'Goal * Goal', one plain 'Goal' with no required marker). Playwright reported a strict-mode violation because [data-semtag-id='preview.fields.item.goal'] resolved to 2 DOM elements with duplicate id='goal', and the browser console logged additional errors after this occurred, confirming the duplicate was not disambiguated and broke independent field addressing.

evidence: The custom 'Quick Project Kickoff Note' template appeared in the grid after submission, could be selected via Use Template, its 3 declared fields were fillable, and Preview Result rendered correctly with all placeholders substituted (Project Kickoff: Website Relaunch, Owner: Alex Rivera, Goal: Launch the new marketing website by Q4.).

Plain-text custom template 'Plain Text Note' rendered in a <pre class=\"whitespace-pre-wrap\"> preserving exact text and line breaks: 'Dear Team,\\n\\nThis is a plain note about the Q3 budget review.\\n\\nThanks,\\nTimothee'. Markdown custom/built-in templates (Professional Resume, Quick Project Kickoff Note) rendered proper headings/emphasis/separators after substitution as verified in FT-8.

After reloading http://localhost:6089/, 'Showing 8 of 8 templates' still includes both custom templates (Plain Text Note, Quick Project Kickoff Note), header Favorites count remains 2, and Professional Resume/Meeting Minutes favorite toggles remain 'on'.
